currency.basis: Historical record: the mark represents the bank's operating period; the source is the mark used for that brand, and no later rebrand of this record exists to prefer.

identity.basis: Fetched vector's own wordmark names the exact full legal-style name of this record (АРКБ «Росбизнесбанк»); РБ monogram matches the known mark of this bank.

assessment.independenceRationale: The aggregator vector's embedded wordmark is self-identifying; the archived official site independently confirms the mark's raster existence and the site's unavailability for color verification.
uncertainties: Official color variant unverified; monochrome candidate proposed.
Aggregator provenance cannot be certified as authoritative; visual quality and identity verified directly from paths.

variant.basis: The proposed candidate is exactly the design carried by the fetched original vector: monochrome black emblem/wordmark on a white field. That variant of the proposed asset is confirmed directly from the source bytes; no alternative variant is being asserted.

candidate.detailsJudgement: All emblem contours, internal gaps and stroke terminals from the source path survive verbatim; the render matches the independent librsvg source reference in shape and color on both themes.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Whole emblem fits the circle with even margins on a 48x48 cell; recognizable and legible at 24/32/48 px on both #FFFFFF and #121212 backgrounds; no clipping of strokes or satellite details.
candidate.rationale: First icon addition for the historical Росбизнесбанк record. The fetched original vector is the bank's full logo; its РБ monogram emblem is the standalone mark, while the accompanying full bank-name wordmark makes the whole lockup unsuitable for a square catalog cell. The emblem geometry is carried over unchanged from the original vector; no tracing or redrawing involved.
candidate.role: Standalone РБ monogram emblem selected from the original full-lockup vector (emblem path reused verbatim); the wordmark is accompanying lettering and is intentionally not part of the catalog mark.
transforms: Selected the emblem path from the original vector unchanged (viewBox 3.8551 82.8851 30.8410 26.9859); no geometry edits.
Uniform scale 0.91710 and translation to center the whole emblem inside a 48x48 canvas (no stretch, rotation or cropping).
Added a white circular field (#ffffff, r=23) per the plain-field circle policy: the source canvas is a uniform white field; transparency outside the circle preserved; no emblem pixel removed.
SVGO 4.1.0 trial on a copy with the repository svgo.config.mjs: 2216 -> 2441 bytes (+10.2%), renders pixel-identical; skipped as a size regression, working bytes kept as final.
candidate.variant: Monochrome black emblem, as carried by the source vector, placed on a white circular catalog backing that reproduces the source's uniform white field; transparency preserved outside the circle.
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: First addition: the frozen base has no icon.svg for this bank, so the visible difference is absence to a real icon; no baseline comparison exists or is claimed.

proposals.reason: Original vector found for the historical Росбизнесбанк mark: https://cdn.worldvectorlogo.com/logos/rosbusinessbank.svg — pure-path SVG (5 paths, no embedded raster/text), trademark-style 192.756 viewBox consistent with EPS-origin vector conversions. Full logo contains the РБ monogram emblem plus mandatory bank-name wordmark (РОССИЙСКИЙ АКЦИОНЕРНЫЙ КОММЕРЧЕСКИЙ БАНК РОСБИЗНЕСБАНК) — direct identity evidence; namesakes Rosbank/RBC excluded. The standalone РБ emblem (first path) renders cleanly and is the catalog-suitable standalone mark; extraction is deferred to candidate preparation, this attempt binds the fetched original. Live www.rbb.ru is unreachable (expired TLS certificate); Wayback captures of the operating-period site are raster-only and the color capture is corrupted, so the official color variant remains unverified — the source vector is monochrome.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Original pure-path vector of the exact bank's logo including its РБ emblem; standalone emblem selection and catalog presentation are prepared downstream from these original bytes.

sources.observation: Vector aggregator asset: 5 pure paths, no raster embeds, fills #fff background + black emblem/wordmark; wordmark spells the exact full bank name of this record, confirming identity; professional path geometry (single-layer, trademark canvas) consistent with an original vector conversion, not an obvious trace.

2020 and 2024 Wayback captures of the official site: header logo is raster-only PNG; the archived big-logo.png capture is corrupted (no usable color reference). Live rbb.ru fails TLS (expired certificate).
